review_scope: Independent post-micro audit of real-A100 StatePassRecord event timing, cardinality, wall/CUDA/synchronization/integrity decomposition, temporary memory, residual CUDA chains, instrumentation minimalism, and integrated-v11 admission.

attempt.correctness: 8/8 exact first resumed tokens and at least 8 continuation tokens per branch

canonical_record_audit.verdict: Every successful-path physical byte and timing sample has one canonical record. Incremental recorder materialization created no synthetic movement record and no duplicate timing owner.

record_cardinality.cardinality_note: The 10 full-state passes are gap-free semantic pass families. The 10,454 records are their measured per-chunk/per-layer/per-run executions plus bounded index and synchronization records; these quantities must not be conflated.

derived_timing_fractions.interpretation: CUDA-event sums, synchronization attribution, CPU record wall time, record spans, and phase wall time overlap. They are separately measured views and must not be added into a waterfall without interval-union analysis.

integrity_timing_qualification.reported_field_definition_from_worker_so: Sum of wall intervals for operations whose name contains sha256.
integrity_timing_qualification.qualification: Raw-bit destination comparison is integrity validation but is excluded from the worker's field named integrity_time_ns. Final reports must label 3.505231979 s as SHA-only and separately report raw-bit validation. The derived 3.990766797 s is an aggregate integrity-work sum, not an additive critical-path latency because pipeline overlap exists.

export_source_chain.measured_chain: destination-index upload -> native index_select -> copy_repack -> D2H -> publish SHA-256
export_source_chain.qualification: The CUDA chain and CPU hash are pipelined; their aggregate durations are not a serial critical-path measurement.

restore_chain.measured_chain: preflight SHA-256 -> owned host snapshot -> consumption SHA-256 -> H2D -> destination-index upload -> native index_copy -> raw-bit validation
dominant_measured_components: preflight and consumption SHA-256 CPU work
4,480 small raw-bit validation launches and their synchronous scalar checks
restore_chain.regular_gpu_optimization_candidate: Fuse destination index/scatter/raw-bit validation over larger page runs; raw validation alone is 63.4% of restore CUDA-event work and shows a 53.6 ms cold/outlier maximum against a 72.336 us median.

residual_chains.reason_hardware_conclusion_deferred: The integrated serving experiment is required to measure state-chain share of HBM reclamation, useful GPU1 capacity, SLO recovery, and rollout interruption.

temporary_memory.measurement_qualification: Pinned extent is tracked from pipeline statistics. Pageable temporary is a 10 ms process-RSS peak delta after subtracting resident checkpoint and pinned extent; a sub-10 ms pageable spike could be missed. The conservative total is the sum of measured pinned and simultaneous restore pageable deltas.

instrumentation.canonical_phase_timing: monotonic wall clock around export and restore
instrumentation.host_memory_sampling: 10 ms process RSS sampler plus explicit pinned/checkpoint extents
instrumentation.qualification: vLLM's built-in CUDA-graph memory profiling ran during engine initialization, before the measured export/restore phases; it is not a heavy causal-phase profiler.

integrated_conditions: Run exactly one integrated v11 transaction with minimal causal instrumentation and the frozen load/trigger/recovery methodology.
Preserve the measured StatePassRecord schema and validate the complete dependency DAG before reporting integrated movement.
Label the current 3.505231979 s integrity field as SHA-only and separately report raw-bit validation; do not add wall, CUDA, and synchronization totals as disjoint stages.
For direct v10-v11 latency claims, match the frozen v10 A100-SXM4 topology or explicitly treat A100-PCIe timing as hardware-confounded. Amplification and byte-count comparisons remain valid.
Do not infer BranchFabric hardware interest from this micro result; integrated critical-path and economic measurements remain mandatory.

measured_vs_inferred_policy.measured: Raw byte counters, tier counters, pass/event counts, event elapsed times, record wall intervals, phase wall times, RSS/pinned/GPU peaks, correctness, GPU identity, and cleanup state come directly from attempt-D artifacts.
measured_vs_inferred_policy.derived: Fractions, throughput, v10-v11 reductions, conservative combined host temp, inclusive integrity-work sum, record timestamp spans, and residual-chain interpretations are arithmetic or reviewer inference over measured fields.
measured_vs_inferred_policy.not_measured: Integrated serving critical-path share, serving SLO improvement, realistic hardware end-to-end speedup, and economic benefit are not established by this micro-validation.
